culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Yuzuru Sada. To explain the truth, Kogoro was knocked out by Conan and placed under the statue. He invited everybody to come where he was and started to explain. He said that it was a murder set up to look like an accident. He told them the hint was the bruise on his cheek. Megure thought he got it because he fell, but Kogoro tells him that was what he thought at first until he looked at the statue. He then asks everybody to look closer at it and tells them its nose is broken. It was a recent rupture due to something hitting it strongly earlier that day. It was, in fact, Kataoka

motive.zhHans: 目暮以为他是因为摔倒才那样的，但小五郎告诉他，那是他最初的想法，直到他看了看那尊雕像。小五郎告诉大家这很奇怪，因为片冈的披风本该被撕破。然而，片冈的尸体上披风并没有撕裂的痕迹，因为他们追的那个人其实并不是片冈。兰说这不可能，因为 Sada 全程都和他们在一起。Sada 说他杀片冈是因为片冈忘掉了已故的妻子，过着奢侈的生活。现任妻子则说这种说法是假的，因为片冈只爱侦探和他的已故妻子。
motive.en: Megure thought he got it because he fell, but Kogoro tells him that was what he thought at first until he looked at the statue. Kogoro tells everybody that it is strange because Kataoka's mantle should have been torn. However, the corpse of Kataoka didn't have a tear on the mantle because the person they were chasing actually wasn't Kataoka. Ran says that it isn't possible because Sada accompanied them all throughout the game. Sada says he killed Kataoka because he forgot about his late wife and lived an extravagant life. The current wife then says that this statement is false because Kataoka only loved detectives and his late wife.

method.zhHans: 他说这是一场伪装成意外的谋杀。之后他被运到假装要摔落的地方，并再次被撞击在石质地面上而被杀死。起初他们追的是片冈，但在游戏中，犯人换掉了真正的片冈，取而代之。假装成片冈并杀死他的人就是 Yuzuru Sada。他利用众人被引开的时机，抄近路穿过宅邸。然后他乔装打扮，袭击了片冈，把他藏在雕像后面。高木和一名警官用音响发出同样的声音，那显然是 Sada 所用的。他提前把声音录在一张 CD 上，并用定时器在适当的时间播出声音。当其他人跑过来时，他抱着片冈的尸体，以掩盖已经沾在他衣服上的被害人的血。
method.en: He said that it was a murder set up to look like an accident. He was then transported to the place where he would pretendedly fall and struck again on the stone floor to kill him. Initially, they were chasing Kataoka but during the game, the culprit swapped out the real Kataoka and substituted himself. The culprit that pretended to be Kataoka and killed him was Yuzuru Sada. He used the moment of diversion to take a shortcut through the manor. He then disguised himself and struck Kataoka, hiding him behind the statue. Takagi, along with an officer, makes the same sound with the stereo, which Sada obviously used. He recorded the sound in advance on a cd and used a timer to broadcast the sound at the right time. He held Kataoka's corpse when the others ran over to disguise the blood of the victim that was already on his clothes.

evidence.zhHans: 之后，他在梯子上留下了片冈鞋子的痕迹，并把它放在自己旁边，制造出他从梯子上摔落的假象。Sada 要求拿出证据，小五郎说他把戏服藏在了篮球里面。
evidence.en: After, he put traces of Kataoka's shoes on the ladder and placed it just next to him to make it look like he fell. Sada asks for evidence and Kogoro says that he hid his costume inside the basketball.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人就是 Yuzuru Sada。为了解明真相，小五郎被柯南击晕并放在雕像下面。他把大家都叫到他所在的地方，开始解说。他说这是一场伪装成意外的谋杀。他告诉他们，线索是他脸颊上的瘀伤。目暮以为他是因为摔倒才那样的，但小五郎告诉他，那是他最初的想法，直到他看了看那尊雕像。然后他让大家仔细看看雕像，并告诉他们它的鼻子断了。那是当天早些时候被某物强烈撞击而造成的近期破裂。事实上，撞到它的是片冈——因此才有那块瘀伤。他解释说尸体倒在人行道附近，如果他是从梯子上摔下来的，就不可能在脸颊上留下瘀伤。他没有从梯子上摔下来。首先，他被人打晕，撞到了雕像。然后他被运到假装要摔落的地方，并再次被撞击在石质地面上而被杀死。之后，他在梯子上留下了片冈鞋子的痕迹，并把它放在自己旁边，制造出他摔落的假象。当他问高木片冈的披风有没有撕裂的痕迹时，高木说完全没有撕破。小五郎告诉大家这很奇怪，因为片冈的披风本该被撕破。他们追他的时候看到他的披风被栅栏挂破了。然而，片冈的尸体上披风并没有撕裂的痕迹，因为他们追的那个人其实并不是片冈。起初他们追的是片冈，但在游戏中，犯人换掉了真正的片冈，取而代之。假装成片冈并杀死他的人就是 Yuzuru Sada。兰说这不可能，因为 Sada 全程都和他们在一起。小五郎打断了她，说有一次他们分开了：在来到后院之前。当 Sada 让他们继续、自己走了另一条路时他们就分开了，那是事先计划好的。他利用众人被引开的时机，抄近路穿过宅邸。然后他乔装打扮，袭击了片冈，把他藏在雕像后面。随后他以 Kaito K 的身份出现在兰和柯南面前。继续追赶的是 Sada。真正的那个人跑进密道时，鞋子完全弄脏了，但自行车的踏板却很干净。就在谋杀之后，他处理掉了戏服并恢复了原样。为了为自己辩护，Sada 问小五郎片冈是怎么发出大家都听到的那声喊叫的。高木和一名警官用音响发出同样的声音，那显然是 Sada 所用的。他提前把声音录在一张 CD 上，并用定时器在适当的时间播出声音。他播出片冈的喊叫声时，片冈还活着。当大家在宅邸里搜寻时，Sada 在后花园杀死了片冈。当其他人跑过来时，他抱着片冈的尸体，以掩盖已经沾在他衣服上的被害人的血。他的失误是声音放得太大了：喊叫声通常传不了那么远。Sada 要求拿出证据，小五郎说他把戏服藏在了篮球里面。柯南玩起那个球，球发出了奇怪的声音。高木找出了戏服和球里面的那块青铜碎片。小五郎解释说，Sada 犯了两个错误：他没有考虑到野猫会把球弄走，也没有意识到那块弹珠碎片会在球里发出奇怪的声响。Sada 供认了罪行，并说他最大的错误是太小看毛利的推理能力。Sada 说他杀片冈是因为片冈忘掉了已故的妻子，过着奢侈的生活。现任妻子则说这种说法是假的，因为片冈只爱侦探和他的已故妻子。
resolution.en: The culprit is Yuzuru Sada. To explain the truth, Kogoro was knocked out by Conan and placed under the statue. He invited everybody to come where he was and started to explain. He said that it was a murder set up to look like an accident. He told them the hint was the bruise on his cheek. Megure thought he got it because he fell, but Kogoro tells him that was what he thought at first until he looked at the statue. He then asks everybody to look closer at it and tells them its nose is broken. It was a recent rupture due to something hitting it strongly earlier that day. It was, in fact, Kataoka that hit it- hence the bruise. He explains the body had fallen near the sidewalk, and that if he had fallen from a ladder it would be impossible for him to get a bruise on his cheek. He didn't fall from the ladder. First, he was struck unconscious by someone and collided with the statue. He was then transported to the place where he would pretendedly fall and struck again on the stone floor to kill him. After, he put traces of Kataoka's shoes on the ladder and placed it just next to him to make it look like he fell. When he asks Takagi if there is a tear on Kataoka's mantle Takagi says it isn't torn at all. Kogoro tells everybody that it is strange because Kataoka's mantle should have been torn. When they were running after him they saw his cape get torn on the fence. However, the corpse of Kataoka didn't have a tear on the mantle because the person they were chasing actually wasn't Kataoka. Initially, they were chasing Kataoka but during the game, the culprit swapped out the real Kataoka and substituted himself. The culprit that pretended to be Kataoka and killed him was Yuzuru Sada. Ran says that it isn't possible because Sada accompanied them all throughout the game. Kogoro interrupts her and says that there was one moment where they separated: before coming to the backyard. They separated when Sada told them to continue as he took the other path, which was a premeditated plan. He used the moment of diversion to take a shortcut through the manor. He then disguised himself and struck Kataoka, hiding him behind the statue. He then reappeared as Kaito K in front of Ran and Conan. The one that continued the chase was Sada. When the real one ran in the secret passageway, his shoes when completely dirty but the pedals of the bike were neat. Just after the murder, he disposed of the costume and rehabilitated himself. To defend himself, Sada asks Kogoro how Kataoka made his cry that everybody heard. Takagi, along with an officer, makes the same sound with the stereo, which Sada obviously used. He recorded the sound in advance on a cd and used a timer to broadcast the sound at the right time. When he broadcasted Kataoka's cry, Kataoka was still alive. As they were searching in the manor, Sada murdered Kataoka in the back garden. He held Kataoka's corpse when the others ran over to disguise the blood of the victim that was already on his clothes. His mistake was that the sound was played too loud: shouts don't usually travel so far. Sada asks for evidence and Kogoro says that he hid his costume inside the basketball. Conan plays with the ball and it makes a weird sound. Takagi uncovers the costume and the piece of bronze inside the ball. Kogoro explains that Sada made two mistakes: he didn't take into account that a stray cat would move the ball and he also didn't realize that the marble shard would make a strange noise in the ball. Sada confesses to the crime and says that his biggest mistake was taking Mouri's reasoning ability too lightly. Sada says he killed Kataoka because he forgot about his late wife and lived an extravagant life. The current wife then says that this statement is false because Kataoka only loved detectives and his late wife.

summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are invited by Eisuke Kataoka, a property tycoon and Kogoro's fan, when they arrives, Kataoka is dressed like a bandit and challenges Kogoro to chase him, but when he was searching him with Kataoka's butler, they hear a scream. And later his son and his second wife discover him lying on the floor after falling of a ladder.

suspects: Yuzuru Sada, Seiya Kataoka, and Yurie Kataoka
